# @web-ts-toolkit/moo

Mongoose helpers for schema fields, ObjectId checks, and document plugins.

## Main Patterns

Partial-index schema fields:

```ts
import { Schema } from 'mongoose';
import { uniqueEmptiableString, uniqueNullableString } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo';

const userSchema = new Schema({
  email: uniqueNullableString('email'),
  username: uniqueEmptiableString('username'),
});
```

Strict ObjectId guard:

```ts
import { isObjectId } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo';

if (isObjectId(req.params.id)) { doSomething(); }
```

Cascade-delete plugin:

```ts
import { cascadeDeletePlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/cascade-delete';

userSchema.plugin(cascadeDeletePlugin, {
  model: 'Session',
  localField: '_id',
  foreignField: 'userId',
});
```

Model-function plugin:

```ts
import { modelFunctionPlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/model-function';

userSchema.plugin(modelFunctionPlugin, {
  fnName: 'fullName',
  fn: (doc) => `${doc.name}`,
});

// static + instance methods `fullName` and `fullNameById` are now available on the model
```

Persisted derived fields (see README "Persisted Derived Fields" for full contract):

```ts
import { Schema } from 'mongoose';
import { defineDerivedField, derivedFieldsPlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo';

type User = { firstName: string; lastName: string; fullName: string };
const userSchema = new Schema<User>({
  firstName: String,
  lastName: String,
  fullName: {
    type: String,
    index: true,
    derived: defineDerivedField<User, 'fullName'>({
      dependsOn: ['firstName', 'lastName'],
      get: (doc) => `${doc.firstName ?? ''} ${doc.lastName ?? ''}`.trim(),
    }),
  },
}, { optimisticConcurrency: true });
// Register source mutators first, then this plugin, then compile the model.
userSchema.plugin(derivedFieldsPlugin);
```

- Stored results are searchable/filterable/sortable/indexable with ordinary MongoDB queries; reads/property access never compute or persist.
- Existing explicit dependencies: no dependency modification/target assignment/pending default write => skip regardless of selection; work requested + all available => recompute; work requested + missing => reject before any getter. An omitted/missing target alone does not request repair.
- Actual pending non-null source/target defaults count as writes without modification flags (including '', 0, false); null/undefined defaults alone do not write. Pending target fallback defaults recompute. Applying defaults to excluded dependencies can queue writes and require rejection even on an otherwise unrelated save; defaults never prove an excluded input available.
- Available = selected (defaults usable, genuine absence without a default is known `undefined`, stored `null` is known) or explicitly fully replaced, including excluded null/undefined/default assignments retained on the same document. Unselected defaults/getters and relative `$inc()`/child modifications are not replacements. No automatic fetch.
- New documents retain their supplied/defaulted/absent input availability on later saves, including with constructor projection metadata.
- Bare getter shorthand recomputes each async validation/save and requires every supported non-derived input, including hidden fields and `_id`.
- Sync/async getters receive isolated readonly partial plain inputs, depopulated ids and copied Date/ObjectId/Decimal128 scalars, no virtuals/derived targets/managed version key/containers. Return `undefined` to clear; staged results use Mongoose setters/casting. Getters/validators must not mutate captured hydrated inputs.
- Root String/Number/Boolean/Date/ObjectId/Decimal128/BigInt only; reject nested/container/Mixed/Union/Binary/UUID/custom kinds, derived chains, immutable/virtual targets, unknown names, malformed options, and duplicate registration. Other ordinary fields coexist but are not getter inputs.
- Reject Mongoose-managed versionKey (default __v or custom) as a target/explicit dependency and omit it from every input view: Mongoose initializes/increments it after pre-save middleware. With versionKey:false, explicitly declared version-like scalar fields are ordinary supported targets/inputs.
- `DerivedFieldsDependencyError`: code `MOO_DERIVED_FIELDS_MISSING_DEPENDENCIES`, frozen path-only `issues: [{ targetPath, missingPaths }]`. Getter failures propagate; casting/validation use Mongoose errors. Rejection preserves application assignments in memory.
- Register source-mutating validation/save middleware before plugin. Normal validation sees results; earlier pre-save changes recompute/revalidate. Later pre-save mutations are outside guarantee; unstable validation-time mutations reject on save. `validateBeforeSave:false` computes/casts but skips required/custom validators.
- Guaranteed writes: hydrated save/Model.create; async document validation computes without persisting. Query updates/replacements/raw writes bypass. insertMany/bulk inserts may incidentally validate, not all-writer support; validateSync/middleware bypass/pathsToSave excluded.
- Backfill old rows/formula changes explicitly (load dependencies, mark target modified, save). Ordinary multi-writer Mongoose concurrency applies; optimisticConcurrency recommended for source/result invariants.
- All helper/error/types also available from `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins` and `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/derived-fields`.

New-document plugin:

```ts
import { newDocumentPlugin } from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/new-document';

userSchema.plugin(newDocumentPlugin, {
  fn: async (doc) => {
    await sendWelcomeEmail(doc.get('email'));
  },
});
```

Keycloak user-sync plugin:

```ts
import {
  createManagedKeycloakClient,
  keycloakUserSyncPlugin,
} from '@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/keycloak-user-sync';

const keycloak = createManagedKeycloakClient({
  baseUrl: process.env.KEYCLOAK_URL!,
  clientId: process.env.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID!,
  clientSecret: process.env.KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET!,
});

// Mapped attribute paths must exist in the schema. pendingPassword is a
// virtual below and is never persisted to MongoDB.
const userSchema = new Schema({
  providerId: String,
  username: String,
  email: String,
  roles: [String],
  tier: String,
  tenantId: String,
  subscription: { plan: String },
});

userSchema.virtual('pendingPassword') // pragma: allowlist secret
  .get(function (this: { $locals: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    return this.$locals.pendingPassword as string | undefined;
  })
  .set(function (this: { $locals: Record<string, unknown> }, value: string | undefined) {
    this.$locals.pendingPassword = value;
  });

userSchema.plugin(keycloakUserSyncPlugin, {
  client: keycloak,
  realm: 'application',
  identifyBy: ['providerId', 'username', 'email'],
  managedRoles: ['admin', 'editor', 'viewer'],
  managedAttributes: ['tenantId', 'plan'],
  paths: { password: 'pendingPassword' }, // pragma: allowlist secret
  syncFields: { email: true, firstName: true, lastName: true, roles: true, attributes: true, password: true },
  passwordTemporary: true,
  mapPassword: (doc) => doc.get('pendingPassword') as string | undefined,
  attributePaths: ['tenantId', 'subscription.plan'],
  rolePaths: ['tier'],
  passwordPaths: ['pendingPassword'],
  mapRoles: (_roles, doc) => (doc.get('tier') === 'pro' ? ['editor'] : []),
  mapAttributes: (doc) => ({
    tenantId: doc.get('tenantId'),
    plan: doc.get('subscription.plan'),
  }),
  onError: reportSyncError,
});
```

## Gotchas

- peer dependency: `mongoose >= 8` (tested with Mongoose 8.24.x and 9.x)
- optional peer dependency: `@egose/keycloak-fluent >=0.12.1 <0.15.0` only for `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/keycloak-user-sync` (tested floor `0.12.1`, current `0.14.x`)
- root entrypoint exports schema helpers, `isObjectId`, and non-Keycloak plugins; dedicated plugin subpaths are also available
- Keycloak user sync is not re-exported from root or `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins`; import it from the direct subpath
- `createManagedKeycloakClient` lazily uses `client_credentials`, renews on demand without timers, and deduplicates concurrent authentication; construct a client directly for custom grants
- `isObjectId(...)` is a strict guard: it rejects strings that `ObjectId.isValid` accepts but that don't round-trip back to the same string
- `uniqueNullableString`/`uniqueEmptiableString` return partial-index field definitions, not full schemas
- new-document plugin runs its callback only after the first successful `save()` of a newly inserted document
- Keycloak sync covers document `save()` and document `deleteOne()`, not query updates/deletes
- Keycloak sync errors are logged and rethrown by default; MongoDB saves have already committed when post-save sync runs
- duplicate-email realms prioritize providerId/username; email lookup is rejected when more than one exact match exists
- Keycloak attributes sync from the `attributes` path or `mapAttributes`; values become string arrays
- use `managedAttributes` for keys the plugin may remove; unmanaged remote attributes are preserved
- use `attributePaths` when `mapAttributes` reads dynamic paths outside the default `attributes` path
- password sync is opt-in with `syncFields.password: true`; map a non-persisted pending-password virtual, not a stored hash or stored plaintext path
- `mapPassword` runs lazily (creation or declared password intent only); declare extra inputs with `passwordPaths`, role inputs with `rolePaths`
- Keycloak loggers receive only `{ operation, localDocumentId, error: { name, code?, status? } }`; `onError` keeps the original error
- cascade delete intercepts only document `deleteOne()`; `post` runs after the parent is removed (abort the transaction to restore); `maxConcurrency` default 8, `batchSize` default 100
- typed filters accept per-field operators (`{ price: { $gt: 5 } }`); no-argument `findDependents()`/`findOrphans()` return `Partial` maps (unsupported entries omitted)
- schema-helper `overrides` win over defaults in both runtime and types
- new-document plugin runs its callback only after the first successful `save()` of a newly inserted document

## Subpaths

- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/is` — `isObjectId`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/schema` — `uniqueNullableString`, `uniqueEmptiableString`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/utils` — `isSchema`, `isObjectIdType`, `isReference`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins` — non-Keycloak plugins (`modelFunctionPlugin`, `cascadeDeletePlugin`, `derivedFieldsPlugin`, `newDocumentPlugin`)
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/cascade-delete` — `cascadeDeletePlugin`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/derived-fields` — `derivedFieldsPlugin`, `defineDerivedField`, `DerivedFieldsDependencyError`, authoring types
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/model-function` — `modelFunctionPlugin`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/new-document` — `newDocumentPlugin`
- `@web-ts-toolkit/moo/plugins/keycloak-user-sync` — `createManagedKeycloakClient`, `keycloakUserSyncPlugin`
